newsitem.title: USA: UPS express volume up 9.5 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: UPS express volume up 9.5 pct in 1996.

text.p: United Parcel Service of America Inc said Friday daily express volume for its domestic and international operations was up 9.5 percent in 1996 compared with volume in 1995.
It said average daily volume for the year was 1,668,000 express packages and documents.
For the fourth quarter, it said it handled an average daily volume of 1,894,000 express packages and document, up by 5.1 percent over the comparable quarter in 1995.
It said domestic express volume for next day, second day and third day service in the fourth quarter was up 4.7 percent compared to the same period in 1995.
International express volume for the fourth quarter grew by 10.3 percent over the corresponding quarter in 1995, it said.
The company said its overall growth was due to improved technology-based services and developments in North America, Europe and Asia.
